claims.summary: For N i.i.d. uniform points in [0,1]^2, depth J with kappa log N <= N 4^(-J) <= K log N, j_1 = J - m, m = floor(theta log_2 N), a shift r >= 0 fixed or r = r(N) with j_1 - r >= 0 and r <= (1/2) log_2 ln N, a coordinate k, and a level-by-level field Phi = sum_{j<J} Phi_j (Phi_j measurable with respect to the counts of levels at most j+1; not necessarily a flow) local at level j_1 - r: if for every j_1 <= j < J and every reachable level-(j-r) square P (it and its ancestors down to level j_1 - r hold at least half their mean counts), P(sigma_P |P|^(-1) int_P Phi_{j,k} >= c_N h_r | F_j) >= p, with sigma_P the sign of the running mean of sum_{i<j} Phi_{i,k} over P, h_r = 2^(-r) sqrt(N/32), c_N > 0, p in (0,1], b = theta log_2(4/p) < kappa/8 and 2 theta + 2b < 1, then with u_N = 4 m h_r/(L sqrt(N log N)), int psi_alpha(4|Phi_k|/(L sqrt(N log N))) exceeds every constant with probability tending to one for alpha in (2, infinity) when (c_N u_N)^alpha - b ln N -> infinity, and for alpha = infinity when c_N u_N >= 2 for large N.
claims.assessment: Working proof, pending review: the proof of thm:coarse-mean-flow-obstruction with its push step replaced by the hypothesis; the walk keeps the child on the event of a push of the step's own coarse mean, which is local by the field's locality (the theorem's mean condition had made its push event equal such an event); area bound, many squares, Chebyshev and cost step as there.
claims.rationale: The coarse-mean analogue of lem:conditional-push-obstruction, containing thm:coarse-mean-flow-obstruction, thm:square-mean-flow-obstruction, cor:lagged-flow-obstruction and cor:coarse-mean-growing-shift (no field it covers beyond them is exhibited): a field local at level j_1 - r whose cost stays bounded with probability bounded below along a sequence of N must, for each admissible c_N and p, at some step and some reachable square fail to push that square's coarse mean along its sign, at every shift up to r* - O(1).
claims.next_action: Build the multi-shift restoring flow, corrections moving coarse means at every shift up to r* - c_0, as a proof object, and decide its legs' pointwise sum.

claims.summary: Let Phi satisfy the hypotheses of thm:coarse-mean-flow-obstruction at a shift r (fixed, or r(N) as in lem:coarse-push-obstruction) except its mean condition, and let xi_P = |P|^(-1) sum_{S in P} (rho_j/2) epsilon_S E_k(S) with F_j-measurable signs epsilon_S. If for every j_1 <= j < J, on every reachable level-(j-r) square P and on the event sigma_P xi_P >= h_r, sigma_P |P|^(-1) int_P Phi_{j,k} >= (1 - lambda_N) h_r with lambda_N in [0,1), then int psi_alpha(4|Phi_k|/(L sqrt(N log N))) exceeds every constant with probability tending to one, for alpha in (2, infinity) when ((1 - lambda_N) u_N)^alpha - 770 theta ln N -> infinity (every fixed lambda < 1 at fixed r; at r(N) under cor:coarse-mean-growing-shift's condition with C replaced by (1 - lambda)^alpha C, c_0 by c_0 + log_2(1/(1 - lambda))), and for alpha = infinity when (1 - lambda_N) u_N >= 2. It covers coarse means differing from the dyadic ones by Delta with sigma_P Delta >= -lambda h_r, and Delta = -lambda xi_P.
claims.assessment: Working proof, pending review: the theorem's push step gives P(sigma_P xi_P >= h_r | F_j) >= p_0 without locality of the signs; on that event the hypothesis gives lem:coarse-push-obstruction's push with c_N = 1 - lambda_N, p = p_0, b = 770 theta.
claims.rationale: Corrections restoring at most a fraction lambda_N of the dyadic coarse push, that is keeping a coarse mean of at least (1 - lambda_N) h_r on the push event, keep the chain; full restoration of the actual push does not meet its hypothesis.
claims.next_action: None on its own; the restoring item's next attempt builds corrections that restore more.

claims.summary: For a rectangle B = [x_0, x_0 + a] x [y_0, y_0 + b] and a piecewise C^1 field w near B with continuous normal components across the pieces' interfaces: int_B w_1 = int_dB (x - c) w.n - int_B (x - c) div w for every real c, so |int_B w_1| <= (a/2)(int_dB |w.n| + int_B |div w|), and the same for w_2 with b; in particular a divergence-free w whose mean of w_1 over B is m has int_dB |w.n| >= 2|m| b.
claims.assessment: Working proof, pending review: div((x - c) w) = w_1 + (x - c) div w on each piece, the divergence theorem summed over the pieces, c at the centre. Elementary; its identity at c = 0 is written in thm:coarse-mean-flow-obstruction's proof; new are the bound and the absence of lem:sibling-exchange-leg's zero-flux hypothesis.
claims.rationale: Prices any mean shift of a square by its boundary flux whatever the flux pattern; at the coarse pushes' sizes the price is of one dyadic step's order, which does not by itself exclude restoring corrections.
claims.next_action: None on its own; used by the restoring item's next attempt.
